code_with:
import os
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.spotify.com/v1"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN']}"}

# Find Mariah Carey tracks.
response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/search",
    headers=headers,
    params={"q": "artist:Mariah Carey", "type": "track", "limit": 3},
)
response.raise_for_status()
tracks = response.json()["tracks"]["items"]

if len(tracks) < 3:
    raise RuntimeError("Fewer than three Mariah Carey tracks were found.")

# Get the current user's ID, as required to create a playlist.
response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/me", headers=headers)
response.raise_for_status()
user_id = response.json()["id"]

# Create the playlist.
response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/users/{user_id}/playlists",
    headers=headers,
    json={"name": "Love Mariah", "public": False},
)
response.raise_for_status()
playlist_id = response.json()["id"]

# Add the three tracks.
response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks",
    headers=headers,
    json={"uris": [track["uri"] for track in tracks]},
)
response.raise_for_status()

code_with:
import requests

token = "YOUR_SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

search_response = requests.get(
    "https://api.spotify.com/v1/search",
    headers=headers,
    params={"q": "The Dark Side of the Moon", "type": "album", "limit": 1},
)
search_response.raise_for_status()
albums = search_response.json()["albums"]["items"]
if not albums:
    raise ValueError("Album not found")

album_id = albums[0]["id"]
tracks_response = requests.get(
    f"https://api.spotify.com/v1/albums/{album_id}/tracks",
    headers=headers,
    params={"limit": 1},
)
tracks_response.raise_for_status()
tracks = tracks_response.json()["items"]
if not tracks:
    raise ValueError("Album has no tracks")

queue_response = requests.post(
    "https://api.spotify.com/v1/me/player/queue",
    headers=headers,
    params={"uri": tracks[0]["uri"]},
)
queue_response.raise_for_status()
